# Outlier

> > Portland, Oregon-based video production company specializing in training, marketing, culture, and corporate storytelling.

Outlier creates professional video content for diverse clients including Puppet, Adidas, ControlTek, Labnet, KinderCare, and IBEW48. The company focuses on delivering high-quality video production services ranging from marketing and recruiting videos to training materials and event coverage.
